notes: Employees: global year-end head count from the 2026 Sustainability Report (Korea 124,564, global 134,585). The business report's own employee table is separate-basis only (128,881 domestic employees with total compensation of KRW 19,799,762 million), so it is not paired with consolidated figures. Payroll: the consolidated 'Wages and salaries' line of the expenses-by-nature note (KRW 37,094,712 million). Judgment call: the note reports no single total staff cost; post-employment benefit (KRW 1,798,189 million) and welfare (KRW 7,448,772 million) are separate lines and are not added. Samsung has no CEO pay ratio.
